title: Sidney Bechet's falling-out with his brother
summary: Sidney and his brother Dr. Bechet became bitter, and Sidney stayed ragged with only his flute and clarinet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: Well, I was going to ask again about the, I keep bringing back the old, I keep bringing back the old times because Patrick Burge. Oh, yeah, I finished telling you about Sidney.
Yes. Sidney fell out with this fellow, his brother, what was playing with me, Doc.

Well, they got bitter against each other. That was so with him because he wouldn't do nothing but play that little flute and that clarinet after he got down to play a clarinet. And he stayed raggedy. He was raggedy as a jay boy.
I know Dr. Bache told me once that he took him down and tried to get him to put him in the home or something. That's right. The police said, no, you take him home, you raise him.
